text.content: 2026-08-17 - R7 formal run cancelled for utilization optimization

The batch-64, selective-activation-checkpointing R7 formal run was intentionally stopped after verified iteration 517 and archived under its original run root. It averaged about 160 samples/s, 63.78%-68.08% GPU utilization, and 55,434-57,968 MiB memory per 183,359 MiB B200, with no nonfinite gradients. Its step-500 matched validation retained the intervention gate: aligned action loss 0.00830196 versus zero 0.00938230 and shuffle 0.00904365, gains of 11.51% and 8.20%. No checkpoint exists because the run ended before step 1,000. This is a cancelled optimization run, not a completed 20k or closed-loop result; R8 starts independently from the same R4 model-only warm start.
